Package hadur.bench

Class Memory

java.lang.Object
hadur.bench.Memory
final class Memory extends Object
BENCH-60 and BENCH-61: the battle JVM heap cap and the memory check before a run. Uncapped children each grew to several gigabytes and filled the host; a cap and a refusal to start when the plan cannot fit keep a long run from being killed by the operating system.
